svg.title: Commercial office floorplan — L3 detail
svg.desc: A furnished office floorplan divided into rooms, each with structure and furniture groups. Exterior walls and shared circulation are independently grouped. Switch to Individual Furniture to inspect the reusable symbols.

g.title: Semantic reconstruction of the furnished commercial office
Wide movable wall to the north lobby
Wide folding partition to the lift lobby
Wide folding entrance from the core passage
Wide folding entrance from the lift return
North corridor — open lobby access to boardroom and reception
Four WC cubicles with individual washbasins
Open return from WC passage to lift lobby
